hotels.description: Discover a 300-year-old Highland manor on the shores of Loch Awe, reopened in 2025 following extensive renovations. This intimate country house features a two AA Rosette restaurant, cosy lounges with roaring fireplaces, and a secluded waterfront setting just 40 minutes from Oban. Set on a peaceful peninsula at the loch's narrowest point, Taychreggan Hotel occupies 40 acres of wooded grounds with direct shoreline access. The property blends 300 years of heritage with contemporary comfort, from four-poster beds and antique furnishings to modern amenities and stunning loch views. Dine at Loch-Smith Restaurant, where locally sourced Scottish ingredients shine, or opt for the light-filled Orangery. Part of the Collection of Romantic Places, this picturesque property offers peace, breathtaking scenery and authentic Scottish hospitality. Whether you're exploring nearby Glencoe and Glen Etive, taking the ferry to Mull and Iona from Oban, or simply unwinding by the loch with a whisky in hand, this historic hideaway delivers an unforgettable Highland getaway.
